owner_and_capability: Workforce — the public modules/workforce planning contracts (StaffShiftPlanning, ShiftTypeAdministration, StaffAssignmentQuery, StaffScheduleOverviewQuery and the ShiftPlanSync port) over the planning commands and queries in modules/workforce/internal/planning; Timetable & Activities — the public timetable.StaffNotices contract over the Tagesinformationen service beside its native repository; the shift-plan-sync application workflow (workflows/shiftplansync) for the #1843 sick cascade and the schedule substitution moves; replacing the dissolved inbound-staff-shifts/adapter compatibility package modules/workforce/legacy/shiftplanning (#3418)
atomic_cutover: The compatibility package is deleted on one branch that merges as one pull request; no file under modules/workforce/legacy/shiftplanning survives it and no Go file imports the path. The shift planning services keep running on the native Workforce Postgres adapter they already ran on through the retained-row shim; the models/schedule Dienstplan repository contracts and the repositories file are deleted, the shim body lives on as the Workforce compose row adapters that the root binds for the retained readers until #3424, and the planning package declares its own row ports over the public capability, so no SQL statement, transaction boundary, advisory lock order or tenant predicate changes. The Tagesinformationen keep the native Timetable repository and move their service and route to that owner. The sick cascade and the substitution moves keep every lock order, fail-closed rule and neutral label and become the shift-plan-sync workflow bound to the absence service through the public workforce.ShiftPlanSync port and to the substitution module through its schedule port. No DDL, no data migration, no write-owner change: the four Dienstplan tables stay with Workforce, the two instance tables and the two notice tables with Timetable, audit.deviation_events with the Audit Platform. The package carried no legacy.jsonl key, so none is retired and none is added; the 44 inbound-staff-shifts compatibility rules are deleted rather than converted, under the epoch-gated exception of ADR 0037.
